title: Depth hints, overlap order, and draw order
plainLanguage: In a 2D poser, “what is in front” matters, but a detector’s depth-like number is not the same thing as a checked drawing order.
purpose: Create reliable front/behind behavior without pretending the system has solved 3D anatomy.

rules.statement: Keep optional depth estimates as provenance/hints only; never treat them as authoritative 3D.
Draw order for assembled artwork must come from a reviewed view/pose compatibility record or explicit authored rule.
Allow draw order to vary by configuration; an arm may be behind the torso in one pose and in front in another.

implementation.currentSupport: Current Corpus Pane records visibility but not a full assembly draw-order rule per configuration.
implementation.futureWork: Add reviewed front/behind relationships to part compatibility tests.
